title: Formula Builder
intro: Type a formula, mark the concepts in it, and turn it into something a reader can hover, drag and step through. Export it for slides, handouts or another web page.
formulas_help: LaTeX, one formula per line, with no colours or labels.
sheet_help: Concepts and how each one looks and moves, kept apart from the formula. Write concept, then indented lines.
sheet_reference: concept NAME: PATTERN · say TEXT · label above|below TEXT · brace above|below TEXT · border · tint · pointer · shape triangle|circle|square · pattern solid|dashed|dotted|wave|double · scrub MIN .. MAX step S = V · slider MIN .. MAX step S = V · edit V · limit MIN .. MAX · hidden NAME MIN .. MAX step S = V LABEL · plot Y over X from A to B, then y from C to D, mark CONCEPT point|rise|curve|intercept x = ... · step CAPTION, then formula N, strike, focus, hide, set NAME = V
prose_help: Link words to a concept with [words](concept).
budget_note: A concept past the colour budget gets a pattern and a number, and no colour of its own.
no_selection: Click part of the formula in the reader view to select it. Click again to select a larger part.
export_header: Made with Formula Builder. Augmentations after Head, Xie and Hearst, Math Augmentation, CHI 2022, doi:10.1145/3491102.3501932.
copy_help: Copy this text and paste it where you need it.
help_scrub: Drag a number with a pattern under it sideways, or select it with Tab and use the arrow keys.
about_text: Formula Builder draws formulas with the augmentations catalogued by Head, Xie and Hearst in Math Augmentation: How Authors Enhance the Readability of Formulas using Novel Visual Design Practices (CHI 2022, doi:10.1145/3491102.3501932). Every concept carries a pattern and a number besides its colour, so the Deutan and Mono views keep its meaning. Everything runs in this tab; nothing is uploaded. Math font: STIX Two, SIL Open Font License. The Deutan preview shows the Colour view as a reader with deuteranopia would see it, so an author can check it.
privacy: Runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.
